requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

3375-4399-4518--228.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4518--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

719-2829-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-2829-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for {0} that dies on enter

1818-1957-2530--203.easyPrerequisites: You either have at least 2 life or {B} available.
1818-1957-2530--203.description:
Cast the creature card from your hand for {0}. The creature enters, then immediately dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature enters, Carnival of Souls and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls ability, adding {B} and losing 1 life.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride ability, gaining 2 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

77-4247-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

967-1308-3809-7087-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

997-2626-3652-4986.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-4460-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-4460-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2034-5003-7717.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Okoye, adding {C}{C}.
When Okoye dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Okoye from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Okoye enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

5902-6575-7704--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent and Doc Samson, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5220-6505-6900-7192.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3019-5644.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Judith
1618-2440-3019-5644.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Judith triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3019-5644.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Judith. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7234.easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least two cards in all hands.
2921-6972-7234.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Realm Seekers.
When Realm Seekers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2510-5639-7070.notablePrerequisites:
There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
You have one or fewer cards in hand.
2510-5639-7070.description:
Activate Arm-Mounted Anchor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Arm-Mounted Anchor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

1651-2499-2573-2638-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2499-2573-2638-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2499-2573-2638-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

774-2232-5478.notablePrerequisites: You have two nonartifact land cards in hand, at least one of which can tap to produce mana.
774-2232-5478.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two nonartifact lands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the lands enter, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-3967-4885.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2511-2906-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2511-2906-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2511-2906-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2511-2906-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1170-2499-2733-5954-6664.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2871-5195-6259.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Seething Anger.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

803-1486-1753-2085.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
803-1486-1753-2085.description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.
803-1486-1753-2085.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1783-4918.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least six creatures.
An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner or Aetherwind Basker.
Aetherwind Basker does not have summoning sickness.
1783-4918.description:
Declare Lightning Runner and Aetherwind Basker as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Aetherwind Basker trigger, causing you to get at least six {E}.
Resolve the Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}, and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
If you control more than six creatures, this combo will net infinite {E}.

4477-4598-5195.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting  Greenwarden of Murasa
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

851-3456-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Rapacious Dragon.
When Rapacious Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1636-2078-2108-5220.notablePrerequisites: Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2078-2108-5220.description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Enatu Golem.
When Enatu Golem dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Enatu Golem trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Enatu Golem on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Enatu Golem from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Enatu Golem enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2815-4050-4891-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {R}.
Atsushi dies, triggering itself and Mortuary.
Resolve the Atsushi trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, causing you to put Atsushi on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling Atsushi from the top of your library and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Activate the three remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Cast Atsushi from exile by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.
